tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. A limestone white with a faint blue cast, never pure grey.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, table bodies, menus and any panel that sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, table header rows, inactive tab track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and table rules. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, table headers on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: bluebonnet
tokens.usage: The brand. Primary buttons, links, focus ring, selected tab. Text-safe on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `bluebonnet-soft`.

tokens.name: bluebonnet-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled with `bluebonnet`.

tokens.name: bluebonnet-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info alerts, the brand badge. Pair with `bluebonnet` or `ink` text.

tokens.name: on-bluebonnet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `bluebonnet` and `bluebonnet-deep` fills.

tokens.name: paintbrush
tokens.usage: Indian paintbrush. The one warm accent: highlights, a single call to action per view, the second series in charts. Not for errors; use `danger`.

tokens.name: paintbrush-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for the paintbrush badge. Pair with `paintbrush` text.

tokens.name: on-paintbrush
tokens.usage: Text on `paintbrush` fills.

tokens.name: firewheel
tokens.usage: Firewheel gold, the yellow tip of the Indian blanket. Fills only: badges, text selection, chart highlights. Never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: on-firewheel
tokens.usage: Text on `firewheel` fills.

tokens.name: winecup
tokens.usage: Winecup magenta. Visited links and the third chart series. Text-safe on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited links. A bluebonnet's white banner spot turns wine-red once the flower has been visited; links do the same.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on `success-soft`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success alert and badge ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert and badge ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: text on `danger-soft`, `surface`, `surface-raised`; fill for the danger button with `on-danger`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert and badge ground.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger` fills.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: One per page at most: landing heroes and empty states.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Peak bloom along TX-16 is expected the first week of April.
styles.usage: All running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Hints, captions, table cells in dense views.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and column headers. Set in caps with CSS, write the source in sentence case.

styles.name: text-mono
styles.usage: Code, coordinates, IDs. Numbers in tables use `text-body` with tabular figures instead.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between a label and its input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between form fields, minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups of fields, alert padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, badges, code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Radio buttons, switch tracks, status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only. Panels on the page use a `line` border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Dialogs.
